svg.title: Enterprise SaaS Module Architecture
svg.desc: Layered diagram showing Core/Shared modules, Domain modules, Tenant-Module registry, and example business configurations
svg.text: Core / Shared modules — always enabled for every tenant

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Auth module and how it works per tenant')
sendPrompt('How does the Tenant module handle multi-tenancy isolation?')
sendPrompt('What does the Audit module track across other modules?')
sendPrompt('How does the User module differ from Auth?')
sendPrompt('Explain the OrgUnit module and how it structures a business')
sendPrompt('What does the Configuration module manage system-wide?')
sendPrompt('How do UOM and Sequence modules help other modules?')

svg.text: Feature modules — reusable, shared across domain modules

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Finance module integrate with other modules?')
sendPrompt('Explain how the Invoice module works with Sales and Purchase')
sendPrompt('How does the Payment module work across different business types?')
sendPrompt('What does the Customer module store and how is it shared?')
sendPrompt('How does the Item module connect to Inventory, Sales and Purchase?')
sendPrompt('What does the Pricing module calculate?')
sendPrompt('How does Warehouse module relate to Inventory?')

svg.text: Domain modules — each is a distinct business unit (plug in / plug out)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What makes the Sales module unique from Purchase and POS?')
sendPrompt('How does the Purchase module handle supplier workflows?')
sendPrompt('Explain how POS module differs from Sales and what it needs')
sendPrompt('What unique workflows does VehicleRental have?')
sendPrompt('How does VehicleService differ from VehicleRental?')
sendPrompt('What would an HR module need from the core and feature layers?')

svg.text: Module registry — tenant-module mapping + dependency resolution

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should I implement the module registry and tenant-module mapping in code?')
sendPrompt('How does dependency resolution work when enabling a module like POS?')
sendPrompt('How does tenant-module mapping work at the database level?')
sendPrompt('Show me what modules a trading company tenant would need')
sendPrompt('Show me what modules a vehicle rental business needs')
sendPrompt('Show me what modules a retail shop with POS needs')
